title: [spec-gap][R-BB-019] /status/queues CoAP diagnostics resource not implemented in any stack (stats plumbing exists)
description: spec/appendix-bufferbloat.md:194 'Expose via /status/queues CoAP resource for diagnostics.' NOT-IMPLEMENTED in all three stacks: Python exposes /status, /status/neighbors, /status/routes, /config only (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/node_resources.py:3-16, resources/__init__.py:5-6); C coap_server registers /status, /config, /neighbors (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c:12; Kconfig:143-151 lists no queues resource); Rust lichen-gateway resources has no 'queues' hits. The stats plumbing is already built and waiting: C lichen_lora_l2_queue_stats_get documented 'Exposed for the /status/queues CoAP endpoint' (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.h:276, impl lora_l2_tx.c:693-714); Python Node.get_queue_stats (python/src/lichen/node.py:1676-1694) returning packets_dropped_deadline/full, max_latency_ms, avg_latency_ms; Rust TxQueueStats with all five spec fields (rust/lichen-core/src/tx_queue.rs:406-425). Suggested placement: add a /status/queues GET handler in Python node_resources.py (CBOR, observable per LCI 17.5.3 pattern), C coap_server.c status handler section, and Rust gateway resources.rs, each serializing the existing stats getters; add LCI conformance vector for the payload shape.
